verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently verify Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, Ki cost, CaC usability, and documented mechanics. Preserve unsupported stamina and version-sensitive values as null.
research_scope: Dynamite Kick — Strike Super / Hercule training acquisition research.

verification_audit.method: Revalidated the existing research record against current Xenoverse 2-specific Dynamite Kick documentation and the maintained mentor/training evidence corpus. Independent Dragon Ball technique documentation was used only as corroboration.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Dynamite Kick was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Dynamite Kick as a Strike Super Attack and documents a 100 Ki cost.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mentor documentation identifies Training with Hercule as the acquisition route; the maintained training guide identifies Dynamite Kick as Hercule's first training reward.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is mentor training rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: Ki cost is directly documented as 100. Stamina cost remains null because no reliable canonical stamina value was established.

records.name: Dynamite Kick
records.skill_description: A chargeable Strike Super in which the user kicks the opponent; charging increases the number and power of the follow-up hits.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence describes a short-range chargeable kick. Charging increases the follow-up sequence, with the move capable of reaching up to 13 hits and ending in knockback. The reviewed evidence indicates substantially greater damage at full charge but does not establish a stable universal numeric damage value or exact frame data; those values are not promoted.
records.acquisition_notes: Training with Hercule is the canonical Xenoverse 2 acquisition route. The maintained mentor/training evidence independently identifies Dynamite Kick as the first Hercule training reward. No Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement is established.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: The chargeable nature creates setup vulnerability, while charging increases the follow-up sequence. Exact frame, hitbox, matchup, and version-specific performance claims remain outside the canonical evidence boundary.
